description:
About Limrun

Limrun gives cloud coding agents access to remote Xcode and iOS and Android environments so they can build and test mobile apps, then share the results through demo videos and interactive previews. Limrun is backed by Y Combinator and is in production at companies including Replit, Rork, and Momentic.

More about Limrun

The role

We’re hiring a Founding Designer to shape our product experience and help people understand what we’re building.

Your main focus will be our product interfaces and user journeys, including Limrun’s console. You’ll also design and improve our website and create materials that explain the product, from presentations and sales materials to digital media and event assets.

You’ll work closely with the founder and engineers, taking ideas from early exploration through implementation. We’re looking for someone who wants to understand the product, asks thoughtful questions, and brings their own ideas about how it should work and look.

What you’ll do

  • Own design for the Limrun console, from user flows and prototypes to detailed interfaces and improvements after launch.
  • Learn how developers use Limrun and turn complex technical workflows into clear, usable experiences.
  • Work with engineers throughout implementation, reviewing the finished product for usability, interaction details, and visual quality.
  • Use customer feedback and lightweight testing to identify confusing steps, explore solutions, and improve the experience.
  • Design website pages that explain Limrun clearly and help people understand how to get started.
  • Create presentations, sales materials, social and digital media assets, launch graphics, print materials, and graphics for event booths and stands.
  • Develop reusable product components, presentation templates, and visual guidelines that keep our work consistent and help the team move faster.
  • Take projects from an open-ended brief to finished work, explaining your decisions and incorporating feedback along the way.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of product design experience, including experience at a software company.
  • A portfolio showing strong product thinking and visual design, with examples of work that shipped.
  • Good judgment about usability, information hierarchy, typography, layout, accessibility, and interaction.
  • The curiosity to learn a technical product and make it easier to understand without losing important details.
  • Comfort moving between product interfaces, website design, and company materials.
  • The ability to explore ideas through prototypes and explain the tradeoffs behind your choices.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers and following through on implementation.
  • Independence and ownership: you ask questions early, propose ideas, respond thoughtfully to feedback, and finish the work.

Experience with developer tools or an early-stage product team would be helpful. Motion design, illustration, and frontend experience are useful additions.

Apply

Share your portfolio and a short introduction. Include product work alongside examples of website or marketing design. Tell us what you personally owned, the constraints you worked within, the decisions you made, and what shipped.
